title: TV remote: the app drawer on a narrow card

steps.path: Home > Media or Home tab, narrow card
steps.headline: On a narrow card, is this bottom bar the right way for the drawer to collapse?
steps.notice: Below roughly 460 pixels the drawer drops under the arrow pad as one row you slide sideways. The Home tab card is always this narrow.
steps.risk: Apps past the first five or six are hidden until you slide the row, and the grid option needs a tap on More.

variants.label: Icon rail
variants.summary: A slim column of app icons to the left of the arrow pad, no names (hover shows one). The app on the TV has a ring. Two columns on a normal card, three on a very wide one, and the icons grow a little.
variants.risk: Quietest and tidiest, but you must recognise an app by its logo alone; the less common ones (Tubi, Plex) are easy to mistake.

variants.label: Launcher grid
variants.summary: A small grid of app icons with names under them, left of the pad, like a phone home screen. Only the first few show, with a More tile that opens the rest.
variants.risk: Easiest to read, but the apps past the first few take a tap on More, and opening them makes the card taller.

variants.label: Name list
variants.summary: A list left of the pad: logo and name on each row, with On now beside the open app. Becomes two or three columns on a wider card.
variants.risk: Clearest labels and best for many apps, but the widest and busiest of the three.
